title: A word the pipeline proposes for the vocabulary
description: A request is a proposal, never an admission. A word joins the vocabulary only when the operator accepts it by name and merges the pull request that adds it to additions.jsonl.

word.description: The normalized search form, as it would be added.

source.description: judge: a model proposed it while judging. submission: a reader's anagram needed it. anchor: a seeded anchor word the engine could not find, which is as often a typo as a real word.

from.description: Where it came from: a queue name, an issue URL, or a candidate id.

why.description: One line on why it was proposed.

gloss.description: A proposed one-sentence meaning. Absent from a submission, where no model is in the loop.

trace.description: A proposed source. Unverified: a model can invent a plausible URL, so this is checked by hand before the word is accepted.

status.description: open: waiting on the operator. declined: refused, and never proposed again. An accepted word leaves this file and appears in additions.jsonl.
